[SWS_DM_01028] Event status bit transitions triggered by Clear- DiagnosticInformation UDS service
⌈
If the clearing of a DTC is triggered by the
UDS service 0x14 ClearDiagnosticInformation, the DM shall reset the Event sta-
tus bits to:
• kTestFailed = 0;
• kTestFailedThisOperationCycle = 0; • kTestNotCompletedThisOperationCycle = 1;
⌋
